name: Pill button (.btn)

href.note: either an internal route, a same-page #anchor, or one of the two allowed app-host URLs

newTab.note: true for every app.withotter.com link in the real source

active.cc-white: transform scale(.95) + elevation.whiteBtnActive — NO TRANSITION, instant

states.transition: color, background-color, border-color only — 300ms ease.outQuart. box-shadow and transform are deliberately NOT transitioned.

notes: Radius 99em (computes to 1584px). Padding .875em 1.25em = 14px 20px. Font 16px/600. Border 1px solid transparent; cc-white overrides border-color to #d6cfc4.
Measured widths are copy-driven: 201.08x46 for 'Create a free profile', 100.04x46 for 'Sign up', 130.98x46 for 'Get started'.
